limits: Control-point bounds are local geometry bounds, not tight painted or accessibility bounds.
Same shape can appear in several controls and multiple paths can compose one icon.
Paint and local transforms are captured separately; factories preserve path geometry only.
Only observed paths are included; neither 42 paths nor the shape labels prove full application coverage.
